speaker: bablu
text: [nervous] [hushed] Madam... locker खाली है।
note: Cold open, 2 a.m., he does not turn round. Scared of saying it, not scared of the dark. Slow on 'Madam', then the fact comes out flat. If it turns comic, drop [hushed].

speaker: meenu
text: [curt] खाली मतलब?
note: Chai glass stopped halfway. Dry, fast, clipped; not yet worried. Very short turn, unstable: budget 3 to 4 takes. If the tag is spoken or the take wobbles, send the bare script text 'खाली मतलब?'.

speaker: bablu
text: [hesitant] मतलब... [apologetic] बीस लाख cash गायब, madam।
note: A beat too slow, as if speed could soften it. The number lands plainly; 'madam' tails away. If it overruns 2.5 s badly, drop [hesitant] and let the ellipsis do the work.

speaker: bablu
text: [sheepish] बस... [matter-of-fact] एक लड्डू रखा है।
note: He is reporting evidence, not telling a joke. No smile in the voice. Simpler fallback: '[sheepish] बस... एक लड्डू रखा है।'.

speaker: meenu
text: [deadpan] लड्डू?
note: Flat disbelief, not weariness and not a sigh. One word, level pitch, small lift at the end. Budget 3 to 4 takes. Fallbacks in order: '[flatly] लड्डू?', then bare 'लड्डू?'.

speaker: bablu
text: [earnest] [eager] मोतीचूर का है, ma—
note: Helpful detail, offered in good faith. 'ma—' is the first syllable of 'madam', cut off by l07; assembly hard-cuts the tail. Reject takes that spell it out ('em-ay'), stretch it to 'maa', or finish the word. If the model cannot do the stub, the director's fallback is to send 'मोतीचूर का है, madam' and cut after 'ma' in the edit; subtitle stays 'ma—'.

speaker: meenu
text: [angry] [sharply] बबलू! [furious, fast] नौ बजे ये cash court में produce करना है!
note: Her loudest line and the only loud one. Whip-crack on the name, then fast and hard through the sentence; stress on 'नौ बजे' and 'court'. Angry officer, not hysterical: no screech, no crying edge. Simpler fallback is the script text '[angry] बबलू! नौ बजे ये cash court में produce करना है!'.

speaker: meenu
text: [thinking aloud] Lock टूटा नहीं... [whispers] [slowly] चाबी से खुला है।
note: The turn of the scene. First half in her normal speaking voice, anger gone, eyes on the padlock. Real pause on the ellipsis, then the scene's only whisper as she works it out. The whisper must still be intelligible. Reject if the whole line is whispered or none of it is. Fallback is the script text 'Lock टूटा नहीं... [whispers] चाबी से खुला है।'.

speaker: bablu

note: He is realising who holds the key while he says it. First sentence is a careful statement of fact; second slows and trails off unfinished, voice dropping. Not an accusation. Fallback is the script text with [hesitant] only.

speaker: meenu

note: Quiet but voiced: louder than the l08 whisper, softer than her normal voice. She finishes his sentence. Weight on 'बड़े साहब'. Reject if it comes out whispered; then retake with '[grim] और दूसरी... बड़े साहब के पास।'.

If it comes out whispered or muffled, retake with '[tense, measured] साहब को कैसे पता चला?', then with the bare line (per script performance note).
